methodology_cards.authority: Use as concentration risk overlay unless adapter provides a hard score.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Health depends on whether dispersion confirms or undermines index moves.
methodology_cards.limits: Low dispersion can mean idle/compressed risk, not automatically bullish.
methodology_cards.authority: Use as soft market-internal evidence unless adapter provides a hard score.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher sustained upside participation is safer.
methodology_cards.limits: Monte Carlo projections are deterministic/reproducible with fixed seeds and are scenario diagnostics, not independent allocation authority. Zombie rallies without breadth confirmation should not lift regime materially.
methodology_cards.authority: Use as internal participation evidence; do not overrule breadth/tail caps.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Undervalued plus quality confirmation is supportive.
methodology_cards.limits: Cheap banks are not buy signals when market regime forbids equity risk.
methodology_cards.authority: Use only with Risk-Adjusted Growth for stock selection.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher breadth is safer / healthier.
methodology_cards.limits: Weak breadth caps bullish interpretation even if news or valuation is supportive.
methodology_cards.authority: Adapter score/regime/bias are authoritative.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher SSI is worse.
methodology_cards.limits: Tail-risk override dominates allocation; do not soften with valuation alone.
methodology_cards.authority: Adapter score/regime/bias are authoritative.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher contagion/complacency stress is worse.
methodology_cards.limits: Use for tail-risk color and avoid list; not a standalone composite score.
methodology_cards.authority: Use as tail-risk evidence; adapter wins if present.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher EVT xi is worse.
methodology_cards.limits: EVT threshold sensitivity is a robustness/confidence diagnostic, not a second bearish vote. A single high xi only becomes a hard cap when elevated/fat-tail classification is robust across thresholds.
methodology_cards.authority: Adapter score/regime/bias are authoritative.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher early-warning score is worse; YELLOW/ORANGE/RED reduce risk budget. Distance, panic, leverage, and cascade vulnerability are supporting diagnostics.
methodology_cards.limits: Pre-shock stress diagnostic, not an exact crash-timing model and not a standalone buy/sell signal.
methodology_cards.authority: ABM v4 early_warning_score/level and adapter score/regime/bias are authoritative when ABM CSV metrics are available.

methodology_cards.score_direction: More positive news is supportive only at short horizon.
methodology_cards.limits: Short-term noise; cannot veto macro, funding, breadth, or tail-risk stress.
methodology_cards.authority: Use as soft overlay unless hard adapter exists.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher economic alpha is better for stock selection.
methodology_cards.limits: Stock-picking tool only; cannot override low AI CIO allocation regime.
methodology_cards.authority: Use with Bank Valuation for bank picks; not a market-regime override.

methodology_cards.score_direction: Higher PVGO means more embedded growth expectation risk.
methodology_cards.limits: Not a crash timing signal; amplifies risk when breadth/liquidity/tail risk are weak.
methodology_cards.authority: Adapter score/regime/bias are authoritative; do not relabel from raw PVGO pct.
